== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ジャワ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">＊敵味方のフォースデッキから、1フォースずつ消費して、配備する。さもなければ、配備できない。タトゥイーンにのみ配備する。他の星系へ移動することはできる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">小柄でネズミを連想させる屑拾い種族。ドロイドを応急修理して売り飛ばす。サンドクローラーに住みついている。たいていの種族に、忌み嫌われる存在である。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Jawa (Dark) (Premiere)]].

'''Lore''' — A small scavenger species that calls to mind a rodent. They patch droids and sell them off. They nest in sandcrawlers. Most species regard them as pests.

'''Game text''' — To deploy, spend 1 Force from each player's Force Deck. Cannot deploy otherwise. Deploy only on Tatooine. May move to other systems.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese uses フォースデッキ rather than Force Pile, and 敵味方 for both players. Movement is to other systems (星系), not “elsewhere”.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-jawa.gif|Original English face]], [[Jawa (Dark) (Premiere)]].</ref>
